fields.body_md:
## About this programme

Thinking of an MSc in data science at Leeds? Here is what it costs, who can get in and the 2027 deadline.

The Leeds MSc Data Science is open to graduates of **any subject**. It runs for 12 months full-time with a September 2027 start. Leeds says you can join even with no prior technical experience.

**The most important fact for you:** the entry bar is a 2:1 in any subject, plus proof of maths. Leeds has a separate Data Science and Analytics MSc for people with a maths, statistics or computing degree.

You study statistics, exploring and visualising data, databases, machine learning and ethical data use. The course ends with a 60-credit capstone portfolio using real datasets, with projects informed by the Leeds Institute for Data Analytics. Teaching comes from the Schools of Mathematics and Computer Science and the Leeds Institute for Data Analytics.

For the wider university, see our [University of Leeds page](/study-abroad/universities/university-of-leeds).

## Can you get in?

**Degree.** You need a bachelor's degree with a **2:1 (hons)** in any subject. A 2:1 is a UK honours grade. Leeds accepts international equivalent qualifications, but the course page gives no percentage or CGPA for India. Contact the admissions team to ask what your marks count as. Leeds also encourages applicants with a 2:2 and relevant work experience to apply.

**Maths.** You must show maths competence. A maths module in your degree can meet this, or a minimum secondary-school grade.

**GRE.** The course page does not mention GRE. GRE is a US-style graduate admissions test.

**English.** IELTS is an English language test. You need **IELTS 6.5** overall with no part below **6.0**.

**ATAS.** ATAS (Academic Technology Approval Scheme) is a UK security clearance that some science and technology courses need before you get a visa. Leeds's course page does not say whether this course needs it. Ask the admissions team when you get your offer. If it is needed, an ATAS application takes at least **30 working days**.

## What it costs

Tuition for international students is **£34,600** for 2027 entry. The page labels it a total for the whole 12-month course.

Leeds is outside London, so the outside-London visa rule applies. This is the worked first-year total.

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Tuition for international students, 2027 entry | £34,600 |
| Living money you must show for your visa: £1,171 × 9 months | £10,539 |
| Student visa application fee, from outside the UK | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge for a visa of just over a year | £1,164 |
| **Total** | **£46,861** |

The sum is £34,600 + £10,539 + £558 + £1,164 = £46,861. Travel and housing are not included.

**Living money is money you show, not a fee.** The visa rule is **£1,171** for each month of your course outside London, up to **9 months**. You must hold this money for **28 days** in a row. The 28-day period must end within **31 days** of the date you apply. You do not pay it to the university.

**Health surcharge.** The Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS) is a charge for using the NHS while you are in the UK. It is set by the length of your visa, not your course. For a course of 12 months or longer, the visa adds up to **1 month** before and **4 months** after the course. That makes a visa of more than a year but under 18 months. You then pay the yearly **£776** plus half of it, **£388**, so **£1,164**.

**Deposit.** If you need a Student visa, you pay a **£2,000** tuition fee deposit to receive your CAS. It is deducted from your tuition fee. It is typically non-refundable, so pay only after you accept an unconditional offer. You need a CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) for your visa. This is the electronic letter your university issues.

For the visa steps, read the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide). To plan the whole budget, use the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Funding

Leeds has two awards that matter for Indian students. They can be combined if the total stays within 100% of your tuition fee.

- **Masters International Regional Scholarship:** **£6,000** off tuition. It is automatic for India passport holders who pay international fees, are self- or partly-funded and hold an offer for September 2027. You do not apply. The page lists the deadline as ongoing. See the [scholarship page](https://www.leeds.ac.uk/scholarship/14/masters-international-regional-scholarships).
- **Masters International Excellence Scholarship:** a tuition discount of **£3,000**, **£6,000** or **£16,000**. You must apply, and you need a 2:1 or equivalent plus strong work or extracurricular experience. Round one closes **28 February 2027** and round two closes **16 May 2027**. See the [scholarship page](https://www.leeds.ac.uk/scholarship/12/masters-international-excellence-scholarships).

With the automatic £6,000 award, the first-year total above falls to **£40,861**. The Excellence award is not guaranteed, so it is not counted.

## Deadlines and intakes

International applicants must apply by **Friday 30 July 2027**. UK applicants have until Friday 10 September 2027. The page shows September 2027 only, so a January start is not confirmed. If you want a scholarship, apply at least one month before the scholarship deadline.

## How to apply

1. **Check the entry rules.** You need a 2:1 in any subject and proof of maths.
2. **Apply online.** Start from the [course page](https://courses.leeds.ac.uk/k319/data-science-msc). Choose September 2027.
3. **Prepare your documents.** You need your degree certificate and transcript, two academic references, a personal statement, an up-to-date CV and your English test result.
4. **Accept your offer and pay the deposit.** Pay the **£2,000** deposit to get your CAS. Apply for the Excellence Scholarship by **28 February 2027** if you want round one.
5. **Check ATAS.** Ask the admissions team if the course needs an ATAS certificate.
6. **Apply for your visa.** You need your CAS, a current passport, proof of funds and your tuberculosis (TB) test result. India is on the UK's TB test list. The test must be at a clinic approved by the Home Office. Read the [TB test page](https://www.gov.uk/tb-test-visa/countries-where-you-need-a-tb-test-to-enter-the-uk) and the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide).

## After the programme

- **Work in the UK after your course.** The Graduate Route lets you stay and work in the UK after your studies. The visa lasts **2 years** if you apply on or before **31 December 2026**, and **18 months** if you apply on or after **1 January 2027**. A September 2027 student applies in 2028, so expect 18 months. The application fee is **£937**.
- **Skills.** Leeds says you will learn to analyse structured and unstructured data and communicate your findings clearly.

## Who it suits

**This programme is a strong choice if:**

- your degree is in any subject and you want to move into data
- you have a 2:1 or equivalent marks
- you want a one-year course ending in a capstone portfolio

**Think carefully if:**

- you have a maths, statistics or computing degree, because Leeds suggests Data Science and Analytics for you
- you need a January start, because only September 2027 is shown
- your marks may fall below a 2:1 and you need certainty before you apply

faq_json.q: How much does the Leeds MSc Data Science cost for Indian students?
faq_json.a: Tuition is £34,600 for 2027 entry. With visa living money, the visa fee and the health surcharge, the first year comes to £46,861, or £40,861 after the automatic £6,000 India award.

faq_json.q: Can I apply to Leeds MSc Data Science without a maths degree?
faq_json.a: Yes. The course takes a 2:1 in any subject, but you must show maths competence, for example through a maths module in your degree.

faq_json.q: Does Leeds need GRE for MSc Data Science?
faq_json.a: The course page does not mention GRE. It asks for IELTS 6.5 overall with no part below 6.0.

faq_json.q: What is the deadline for Leeds MSc Data Science 2027?
faq_json.a: International applicants must apply by Friday 30 July 2027. UK applicants have until Friday 10 September 2027.

faq_json.q: Is there a scholarship for Indian students at Leeds?
faq_json.a: Yes. The Masters International Regional Scholarship gives India passport holders £6,000 off tuition automatically. The Excellence Scholarship gives £3,000, £6,000 or £16,000 and closes on 28 February 2027 in round one.
